title: Genres
canvas: Genre graph. Use search for keyboard navigation.
error: Could not load the genre map.
partial: This is a partial collection. Some genres or relationships may be missing.
invalidNode: This genre is not in the current snapshot. Showing the full map.
filteredEmpty: No relationships match the selected filters.
help: Select a genre to explore its connections. Drag to pan; scroll or pinch to zoom. All genres are also available through search.
interpretation: Node size represents the number of connected genres in this snapshot. Position and distance help organize connections; they do not measure popularity or listening similarity. Multiple parents and cycles are preserved.
completeMeaning: Complete means this collection finished. It does not mean every musical genre or relationship is covered.
